Option A — apply the patch on a fresh e8-file-server checkout:
  git checkout -b cursor/output-task-thumbnails-5528
  git am path/to/0001-output-task-thumbnails.patch

Option B — copy these three files into e8-file-server/src/ (overwrite):
  thumbnail.js
  thumbnailQueue.js
  thumbnailWorker.js

Then commit, deploy, and restart the file-server process (PM2 / Docker /
Cloudflare Container).

Required env on the file-server (must match the main app):
  APP_URL       = https://<your-app-host>   (receives /api/internal/thumbnail-complete)
  CRON_SECRET   = same secret the app uses for internal webhooks

After deploy, from the main app (admin):
  POST /api/admin/backfill-output-thumbnails

Or wait for the every-minute cron /api/cron/backfill-task-thumbnails.
